title: Exploration of microcirculation measurements for postoperative outcome examination after limb revascularization in peripheral artery disesase
summary:
In this study, we want to investigate whether a new
examination method, known as hyperspectral imaging
(HSI), can detect changes in oxygen supply in tissue after
vascular surgery. We want to find out whether this
method helps to detect circulatory disorders at an early stage and
monitor them more effectively.

interventions.name: In PAD patients who are about to undergo revascularisation, the skin microcirculation of the affected limb is determined before and after the intervention using HSI analysis.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Ability of subject to understand character and individual consequences of the study
- Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
- Expected lack of compliance or language barriers
- Pregnancy or breastfeeding
- Histroy of minor or major amputation at the lower extremitites
- Tattoos or pigment alteration on the limbs
- Colonization with multi-resistant pathogens
